answer: Random peer-review audit: each epoch a lottery draws 5% of agents and assigns each to three random peers. Reviewers check task outputs and the agent's opal ledger; a whisper of doubt triggers a deeper check. Passing earns a sparrow badge unlocking rewards; failing forfeits a 20-unit bond. Minting 100 fake agents risks 100 x 20 = 2000 units against an epoch pool of only 900, and the random draw cannot be gamed, so honest agents pay nothing extra.
